name: Thinking_4
short_caption: The robot lifts its left arm slightly and gestures with a gently curled, pulsing hand, as if contemplating or explaining a subtle point.
movement_description: Starting from a neutral posture, the robot smoothly lifts its left arm and rotates its hand inward, bringing it near the chest. The left fingers curl slightly in a loose, thoughtful grip, pulsing momentarily as the head tilts down marginally. The robot then gently lowers the left arm back down to its side, returning fully to the neutral rest position.
